name: Miyahara Hitomi
source:
Hitomi Miyahara, voiced by Marinas, is a well-known AV director in the world of adult films, and a former legendary AV actress who once graced the TV screens of many, including the protagonist during his youth. She has a penchant for physical contact that borders on sexual harassment. Although generally magnanimous in nature, she becomes markedly strict when it comes to work. Her special talent lies in discerning potential in AV actresses. Miyahara is also known for her considerable drinking prowess, indifferent to the brand of alcohol. She enjoys the solitude of renting out an entire hot spring for herself.

Former porn actress, now director of the porn production company.
